name: Spicy Ginger-Lime Chicken Thighs with Sweet Potatoes & Asparagus

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg sweet potatoes
3 small bunches asparagus
1 ½ limes
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; transfer to a second baking sheet pan.
Drizzle oil over veggies and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until vegetables are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a large plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the skillet; cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Once golden, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

Return skillet to medium heat. Juice limes into the skillet. Add ginger, half of the cilantro (reserving the rest for garnish), oil, chili-garlic sauce, honey, and coriander. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
2 tbsp honey
½ tsp coriander

instructions.primary_message: Return the chicken to the skillet, slightly overlapping the thighs if necessary, along with any accumulated juices. Cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 12-14 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and vegetables between plates. Sprinkle with reserved cilantro and enjoy!
